legend: H gloss Q293, signed عبد الرحيم
legendMeaning: مط: unrestricted inclusion of proposition truth conditions. حم: lower proposition has wider truth-condition extension than upper. Neither mark by itself proves a modal necessity theorem.
secondPrint: H1433 Q294 whole-page witness exists, but each of these eight cells still needs a separate comparison against it.
